safety_verdicts.content: Patient is taking the Clenil inhaler every day, 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated lists Clenil/Qvar but does not document the baseline regimen of Clenil every day at 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting the patient’s baseline controller inhaler regimen (Clenil 2 puffs twice daily) can lead to misunderstanding of current asthma control and inappropriate step-up/step-down decisions, potentially resulting in suboptimal treatment during an exacerbation. This is clinically relevant because dosing/frequency informs severity assessment and safety advice.
